description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: Habakkuk asks God how long violence and injustice will go on. God answers that the Babylonians are coming, and Habakkuk asks how God can use the wicked to punish those more righteous than they.
1.sw: Habakuki anamwuliza Mungu jeuri na udhalimu vitaendelea mpaka lini. Mungu anajibu kwamba Wakaldayo wanakuja, na Habakuki anauliza Mungu anawezaje kuwatumia waovu kuwaadhibu walio waadilifu kuliko wao.
1.am: ዕንባቆም ዓመፅና ግፍ እስከ መቼ እንደሚቀጥሉ እግዚአብሔርን ይጠይቃል። እግዚአብሔርም ከለዳውያን እንደሚመጡ ይመልሳል፤ ዕንባቆምም እግዚአብሔር ከእነርሱ የበለጠ ጻድቃንን ለመቅጣት ክፉዎችን እንዴት ሊጠቀም እንደሚችል ይጠይቃል።

2.en: God tells Habakkuk to write the vision plainly, for it will surely come; the righteous will live by their faithfulness. Five woes are pronounced on the proud oppressor.
2.sw: Mungu anamwambia Habakuki ayaandike maono waziwazi, kwa maana hakika yatakuja; mwenye haki ataishi kwa uaminifu wake. Ole tano zinatangazwa juu ya mdhalimu mwenye kiburi.
2.am: እግዚአብሔር ዕንባቆምን ራእዩን ግልጽ አድርጎ እንዲጽፈው ይነግረዋል፤ በእርግጥ ይመጣልና፤ ጻድቅ በታማኝነቱ በሕይወት ይኖራል። በትዕቢተኛው ጨቋኝ ላይ አምስት ወዮታዎች ይታወጃሉ።

3.en: Habakkuk prays for God to remember mercy in wrath and describes God's coming in power. Though the fig tree does not flower, he will rejoice in God his savior.
3.sw: Habakuki anaomba Mungu akumbuke rehema katika ghadhabu na anaeleza kuja kwa Mungu kwa nguvu. Ingawa mtini hautoi maua, atafurahi katika Mungu, Mwokozi wake.
3.am: ዕንባቆም እግዚአብሔር በቍጣው ምሕረትን እንዲያስብ ይጸልያል፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም በኀይል መምጣት ይገልጻል። በለስ ባታብብም እንኳ አዳኙ በሆነው በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይለዋል።
